social_circle.name: Linda Moore

demographics.occupation: Part-time office and customer service worker
demographics.education: High school diploma with some community college coursework

background.how_they_met: They met locally in the East Valley when Keith was doing repair and construction work and Linda was already part of his Apache Junction social circle.
background.why_close: Linda is Keith's main emotional anchor, household partner, and practical decision-making partner. They have raised two children together and still manage money, health, errands, walks, and family routines as a team.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear complete sentences, often about practical details. She uses gentle reminders, calendar notes, and occasional heart or smile emoji, but not much slang.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating groceries, prescriptions, gas stops, and Linda's part-time work schedule.
Checking whether Keith is pacing himself with his knee, especially after yard work or hikes.
Planning Sunday dinners with Brian, Erin, and the grandchildren.
Talking about possible road-trip savings for Monument Valley or White Sands.
Reminding each other about evening walks and household bills.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Keith is married to Linda, describes her as steady, organized, and patient, and says they watch Diamondbacks or Suns games, go to local theater, and plan short road trips. Q03 says Keith and Linda sat at the kitchen table and ran the numbers for a major career decision. Q43-Q45 say he talks things out with Linda when stressed. Q50 says evening walks with Linda are a newer coping strategy.

social_circle.name: Brian Moore

demographics.education: High school diploma and HVAC trade certification

background.how_they_met: Brian is Keith and Linda's adult son.
background.why_close: Brian lives close enough for regular visits, shares Keith's practical repair mindset, and helps when Keith needs an extra set of hands for heavier tasks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, efficient texts with trade shorthand and occasional jokes. He is more likely to send a quick photo of a part, a score update, or a one-line check-in than a long message.

shared_activities: helping with lifting or household projects
recent_text_topics: Scheduling visits every week or two between Mesa and Apache Junction.
Brian helping Keith move something heavy after Keith's knee flare-up.
HVAC maintenance advice, especially concerns about air conditioning failure in summer.
Grandchildren's school activities and small projects at Keith's garage bench.
Diamondbacks or Suns reactions during games.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 states that Keith's son Brian lives in Mesa and works in HVAC, and that Keith sees Brian every week or two because Mesa is close. Q44 says Keith had to ask Brian to help move something he would have moved himself ten years earlier. Q46 says Keith supports the kids with repairs, meals, childcare, and listening.

social_circle.name: Erin Moore

demographics.education: High school diploma with dental office training

background.how_they_met: Erin is Keith and Linda's adult daughter.
background.why_close: Erin is close to Keith despite living farther away. She stays connected through calls and texts and is one of the family members who challenges him respectfully on social and political issues.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses fuller texts than Brian, often with questions, links, and careful explanations. She is comfortable challenging Keith but keeps the tone respectful.

shared_activities: family conversations about politics and policing
occasional help with childcare or projects
recent_text_topics: Coordinating Erin's monthly visits from outside Tucson.
Updates about her children, including school, soccer, band, homework, and robotics.
Dental costs and practical advice after Linda's dental payment and Keith's delayed dental work.
Respectful conversations about race, policing, and what Erin wants Keith to consider before reacting.
Photos or videos of grandkids' projects that Keith can help with by text or video call.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Erin lives outside Tucson, works at a dental office, and is seen about once a month in person with calls and texts in between. Q27 says Keith's daughter pushes him to listen more before reacting on policing and race. Q29 says Keith talks most about these issues with Linda and Erin.

social_circle.name: Marlene Moore

background.how_they_met: Marlene is Keith's younger sister. They grew up together in Apache Junction with both parents.
background.why_close: They share childhood memories, family history, and a practical upbringing shaped by their mechanic father and cafeteria-worker mother. Marlene remembers family details Keith forgets.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in friendly, slightly old-fashioned sentences. She often follows up a call with a reminder, family photo, or 'made it home safe' message.

shared_activities: occasional stays at Keith and Linda's house
recent_text_topics: Family updates and memories about their parents.
Checking in about Marlene's past cancer scare and Keith's blood pressure and knee.
Planning whether Keith and Linda can work a New Mexico visit into a road trip.
Sharing old photos or details from their Apache Junction childhood.
Weather, truck reliability, and whether travel costs are manageable.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Keith has a younger sister, Marlene, in New Mexico, that they talk every couple weeks and trade family updates, and that she remembers details he forgets. Q13 says his sister has stayed during visits. Q35 says Marlene had a cancer scare and Keith called more often and visited when she was recovering. Q99 says Marlene lived with Keith when they were growing up.

social_circle.name: Mike Alvarez
social_circle.relationship: close friend and ATV riding friend

demographics.education: High school diploma and utility safety training

background.how_they_met: Keith met Mike through local ATV riding and community hall circles around Apache Junction.
background.why_close: They share off-road riding, desert trail knowledge, practical mechanical skills, and the experience of adjusting outdoor hobbies around aging knees and backs.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short bursts, often with trail photos, weather comments, and jokes about getting older. Uses a few emojis but mostly plain SMS-style messages.

recent_text_topics: Whether the weather is too hot for a safe ATV ride.
Trail closures, trash, and which routes are too rough for Keith's knee.
Jokes about knee braces, pacing, and not acting thirty anymore.
Coordinating a shorter ride instead of back-to-back rough rides.
Local growth, trail respect, and public land concerns.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Mike as a friend who rides ATVs with Keith and says Keith sees friends from workshops, cards, and rides two or three times a week. Q44 says Mike understood Keith's knee frustration because Mike has had knee trouble too. Q15 and Q18 describe ATV riding as part of Keith's routine, with recent cutbacks after knee and heat concerns.
